title.en: Add language-specific Dashboard learning tiles and two-part acceptance plan
title.zh: 新增按语言区分的用户面板学习入口与两部分验收计划

purpose.en: Make every signed-in learning entry explicit, language-aware, and directly testable while defining separate anonymous Play and member Dashboard acceptance suites.
purpose.zh: 让每个登录学习入口独立、明确携带学习语言并可直接验收，同时分别定义匿名 Play 与会员用户面板测试。

en: Split Smart Card Practice and Smart Card Challenge into independent Dashboard tiles.
List subscribed learning languages in every Dashboard learning item with independent selection and a visible current-language label.
Add a Choose another language or subscribe action to every Dashboard learning item.
Keep Today’s Sprint, Everyday speaking, subscribed courses, and Ask AI language-aware.
Replace the production acceptance plan with exactly two parts covering all six anonymous Play tiles and every signed-in Dashboard tile.
zh: 将智慧卡练习和智慧卡挑战拆分为独立用户面板入口。
每个用户面板学习项目列出已订阅语言，可独立切换并显示当前语言。
每个学习项目增加选择其他语言或订阅课程入口。
今日速成、生活口语、已订阅课程和咨询 AI 均明确携带学习语言。
生产验收计划严格分为两部分，覆盖匿名 Play 六个入口和登录用户面板全部入口。

en: Signed-in Dashboard learning hub, auth completion locale handoff, and live production acceptance documentation
zh: 登录用户面板学习中心、登录完成语言跳转及生产验收文档

en: Dashboard languages continue to derive only from active subscribed courses.
Each learning tile preserves its own selected-language state and sends that language in the destination URL or course context.
The acceptance matrix tests Chinese-to-Japanese first and English-to-Italian second across anonymous and member boundaries.
Use the already validated interface locale when completing the Clerk session bridge.
zh: 用户面板语言仍只来自有效订阅课程。
每个学习入口独立保留所选语言，并在目标 URL 或课程上下文中携带该语言。
验收矩阵先测试中文学日文，再测试英文学意大利文，并覆盖匿名与会员边界。
Clerk 会话完成桥接使用已经验证的当前界面语言。

en: Targeted Dashboard, Sprint, acceptance-plan, localization, and Clerk tests passed.
SmartLingo shared policy, architecture, base-feature, and contract gates passed.
Vinext production build, diff check, sensitive-data scan, and local anonymous Play browser verification passed.
zh: 用户面板、速成、验收计划、本地化及 Clerk 目标测试通过。
SmartLingo 共享政策、架构、基础功能及契约检查通过。
Vinext 生产构建、差异检查、敏感数据扫描及匿名 Play 本地浏览器验证通过。

en: No tests are intentionally deferred for this Dashboard and acceptance-plan release.
zh: 本次用户面板与验收计划发布没有有意延期的测试。

en: Preserve SmartLingo branding, subscribed-course boundaries, Clerk, Cloudflare, AI, commerce, and site-owned data.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 品牌、订阅课程边界、Clerk、Cloudflare、AI、商业及站点自有数据。
